Courses Covered View Complete list Mission & Goals Mission The Collaborative Learning Center (CLC) provides comprehensive tutoring and academic support services that reinforce classroom instruction. CLC promotes the College’s efforts to enable students to realize their intellectual potential by encouraging active engagement, critical thinking, and development of skills for academic success. Goals Deliver instructional support services that aid in the development of academic skills. Facilitate use of auxiliary tutoring services to support student academic needs. Train tutors to support students enrolled in Math, English and Science Gateway courses to address high DFWI percentages. Our Student-Centered Philosophy Students benefit from a student-centered perspective on challenging or confusing course material. Purpose of tutoring sessions: Students seek answers to their questions and content clarification. They are guided to describe, work with, and address their own personal challenge areas. Our minimalist, student-centered approach to tutoring encourages students to take an active role in all components of the learning process. Student-centered tutoring shifts the responsibilities of performing learning activities from the tutor to the learners. Putting this theory into practice allows students, guided by tutors, to take ownership of their learning and hone their critical thinking and analytical skills. As such, our session policy reflects this philosophy. Tutoring sessions are either 25 or 50 minutes long . If you would like additional tutoring, you must wait 30 minutes between sessions. We encourage you to use this time between sessions to practice and apply what you have learned in your previous session.
